/e apple
/e bloxycola
/e superheal

/e bat

-- Kitchen-Controls
/e foodevent
-- Basement-Controls
/e unlockbasement
/e basementlights
/e equipladder
/e dropladder
scripts.script:
game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Chatted:Connect(function(Msg)
    local RepStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local RepEvents = RepStorage:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvents")
    -- Tool-Controls
    if Msg == "/e pizza" then
    RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("Pizza3")
    elseif Msg == "/e epicpizza" then
        RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("EpicPizza")
    elseif Msg == "/e chips" then
        RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("Chips")
    elseif Msg == "/e pie" then
       RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("Pie")
    elseif Msg == "/e apple" then
        RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("Apple")
    elseif Msg == "/e bloxycola" then
        RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("BloxyCola")
    elseif Msg == "/e superheal" then
        RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("Cure")
    elseif Msg == "/e medkit" then
        RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("MedKit")
    elseif Msg == "/e bat" then
        RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("Bat")
    elseif Msg == "/e linkedsword" then
        RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("LinkedSword")
    elseif Msg == "/e lollipop" then
        RepEvents.GiveTool:FireServer("Lollipop")
    -- Kitchen-Controls
    elseif Msg == "/e foodevent" then
        RepEvents.BloxyPack:FireServer(1)
    -- Basement-Controls
    elseif Msg == "/e unlockbasement" then
        RepEvents.UnlockDoor:FireServer()
    elseif Msg == "/e basementlights" then
        RepEvents.BasementMission:FireServer()
        RepEvents.basementLights:FireServer()
    elseif Msg == "/e equipladder" then
        RepEvents.Ladder:FireServer(1)
    elseif Msg == "/e dropladder" then
        RepEvents.Ladder:FireServer(2)
      end
  end)
